text:
Maya (CS): Quick check-in on Optima's private deploy — week 1. Network team reported 2 blocked items: egress firewall & transit gateway peering. Need eng/SRE to confirm NAT egress IPs and KMS key rotation plan. Also FYI renewal flagged as 'at risk' if cutover slips past Mar 15.

Oliver (SE): On the NAT IPs — we're assigning static Elastic IPs. I'll post the list by EOD. Also can we get the exact firewall rule ranges from Optima?

Maya (CS): They sent ranges: 10.11.0.0/22 and 10.12.0.0/24 for the app subnets. I asked them to confirm the management CIDR for the peering.

Diego (SRE): For transit gateway peering we need their ASN and BGP creds. @Maya can you confirm? Also audit logs: Optima wants event push to their Splunk HE C endpoint — we need ingestion URL + cert.

Jenna (PM): Noted on renewal risk — I'm tracking in Salesforce. If cutover > Mar 15 we mark as at-risk and trigger sales outreach. I'll coordinate CS -> Sales if we hit blockers.

Kevin (Eng): Sharing a quick Terraform snippet for KMS setup to match our expected grant model — use this as a starting point and adjust ARNs:

```
resource "aws_kms_key" "optima" {
  description      = "Optima customer key"
  rotation_enabled = true
}

resource "aws_kms_grant" "redwood_infer" {
  key_id            = aws_kms_key.optima.key_id
  grantee_principal = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-infer"
}
```

Oliver (SE): I'll validate the snippet and run plan in our sandbox account. If anyone has a preferred KMS alias naming convention for customers, shout now.

Maya (CS): Thanks. Action items: 1) @Oliver post EIP list + confirm firewall rules with Optima; 2) @Diego confirm BGP creds + Splunk ingestion endpoint/cert; 3) @Kevin verify KMS policy meets SOC2 logging requirements. Capturing feedback: Optima asked for clearer, step-by-step runbook notes for private cutover — adding link: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/private-cutover

onboard-bot: Checklist updated — "EIP assigned" checked; "KMS rotation" pending. Link: https://redwood.example.com/checklists/optima

Diego (SRE): Quick question — do we require the customer's CA cert for Splunk HECEndpoint, or do we proxy logs from our collector? If they can't provide a cert we can do mutual TLS from our side, but need confirmation.

Kevin (Eng): We prefer mutual TLS with a customer-provided cert, but we can support proxying for short term. I'll add a cert-upload script and a runbook subsection for Splunk ingestion.

Maya (CS): Great — goal is to clear these blockers by EOD tomorrow so we don't slip the cutover. I've scheduled a follow-up: Wed 10am PT — calendar invite sent. :thumbsup: 

Oliver (SE): Roger, will post EIPs shortly.

Jenna (PM): I'll update the renewal risk tracker after tomorrow's follow-up.

Kevin (Eng): Adding runbook PR with KMS + Splunk steps now.

Maya (CS): Thanks team — let's capture any follow-up notes after the call and mark the checklist complete. :eyes:
